Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Subtitle: Changes are saved immediately to %LOCALAPPDATA%\RSSAM\settings.json and restored at startup.
Settings.Language.Title: Language
Settings.Language.Description: Sets the language used by the RSSAM interface.
Settings.Theme.Title: Theme
Settings.Theme.Description: Choose the app theme or follow the Windows setting.
Settings.Backdrop.Title: Window backdrop
Settings.Backdrop.Description: Select Mica, Acrylic, or a standard window background.
Settings.CompactNav.Title: Compact navigation
Settings.CompactNav.Description: Uses a narrower icon-based navigation pane on the left.
Settings.StatusBar.Title: Show status bar
Settings.StatusBar.Description: Shows or hides the status bar at the bottom of the application.
Settings.LoadGames.Title: Load games at startup
Settings.LoadGames.Description: Automatically loads the Steam game list after RSSAM starts.
Settings.ConfirmStore.Title: Confirm before saving
Settings.ConfirmStore.Description: Asks for confirmation before changed achievements and statistics are sent to Steam.
Settings.ConfirmReset.Title: Confirm before reset
Settings.ConfirmReset.Description: Requires additional confirmation before resetting statistics or achievements.
Settings.Success.Title: Success messages
Settings.Success.Description: Shows successful button-initiated reload and save actions in InfoBars.
Settings.StatEdit.Title: Enable statistics editing by default
Settings.StatEdit.Description: Enables editing of unprotected statistic values when a game is opened.
Settings.Config.Title: Configuration file
Settings.Config.Description: The central JSON file stores application, window, shell, navigation, and search state and can be opened directly.
Settings.About.Version: Version {0} · WinUI 3 redevelopment and modifications: riggi89 · 2026
Settings.About.Description: RSSAM is based on the open-source Steam Achievement Manager (SAM) project by Rick (Gibbed). The original Steam API integration and parts of the schema/statistics logic were retained under the zlib license and adapted for .NET 10 / WinUI 3.
Settings.About.LicenseText: The fork, original-project, modification and zlib third-party notices are in LICENSE.md. Additional information about the RSSAM port is available in NOTICE.md and README.md.
Settings.About.Copyright: RSSAM modifications: Copyright © 2026 riggi89 · Original Steam Achievement Manager: Copyright © Rick (Gibbed).
Settings.About.NoteMessage: Steam must be running and you must be signed in with the account whose games and achievements you want to manage.
Info.AutoLoadDisabled: Automatic loading is disabled. Use 'Reload games' in the CommandBar.
Dialog.Store.Title: Save changes?
Dialog.Store.Content: The selected achievement and statistic changes will be sent to Steam.
Dialog.ResetConfirm.Title: Confirm reset
Dialog.ResetConfirm.Content: This action can permanently change many values. Do you really want to continue?
Dialog.ResetScope.Title: What should be reset?
Dialog.ResetScope.Content: Choose whether all achievements should also be reset together with the statistics.
Dialog.SettingsReset.Title: Reset settings?
Dialog.SettingsReset.Content: All RSSAM settings will be reset to the defaults for version {0}.

Core.Steam.UnsupportedArchitecture: RSSAM's Steam integration supports x86 and x64 builds only.
Core.Steam.InstallPathMissing: The Steam installation could not be found. Install or repair Steam, then start RSSAM again.
Core.Steam.ClientLoadFailed: The Steam client library for this RSSAM architecture could not be loaded. Restart Steam and RSSAM, then reinstall the matching x86 or x64 build.
Core.Steam.SessionBusy: Another RSSAM Steam operation did not finish in time. Close and reopen RSSAM, then try again.
Core.Steam.InterfaceFailed: RSSAM could not obtain the required Steam client interface. Update and restart Steam, then try again.
Core.Steam.PipeFailed: RSSAM could not connect to the running Steam client after several attempts. Start Steam completely, sign in, and run Steam and RSSAM at the same privilege level (normally: neither as administrator), then reload.
Core.Steam.UserConnectionFailed: RSSAM connected to Steam but could not access the signed-in user. Sign in to Steam and reload.
Core.Steam.AppIdMismatch: The isolated Steam helper received a different App ID. Wait a moment and open the selected game again.
Core.Steam.WorkerUnavailable: The isolated Steam helper could not be executed: {0}
Core.Steam.UnknownFailure: The Steam client connection could not be initialized.
Core.Catalog.Fallback: Online list unavailable – searching installed games …
Core.Catalog.NotOwned: This Steam account does not own the specified app.
Core.Stats.LoadInProgress: Steam statistics are already being loaded.
Core.Stats.Timeout: Steam did not respond to the statistics request in time.
Core.Stats.LoadFailed: Steam could not load the statistics (Result {0}). A common cause is that the game is not owned by the account.
Core.Stats.SchemaFailed: The Steam statistics schema for this game could not be loaded.
Core.Stats.AchievementProtected: Achievement '{0}' is protected and cannot be changed.
Core.Stats.StatProtected: Statistic '{0}' is protected and cannot be changed.
Core.Stats.ValueOutOfRange: The value for '{0}' must be between {1} and {2}.
Core.Stats.MaxChange: Statistic '{0}' may change by no more than {1} at a time.
Core.Stats.StoreFailed: Steam could not persist the changes.
Core.Stats.ResetFailed: Steam could not reset the statistics.
